protocol.timing: Local application-service caller: immediately before enqueue through run_turn and final get. Includes authorization, model/tool calls, computation, persistence and completed-turn retrieval. Excludes fixture ingestion, fresh platform/thread construction, post-turn scoring, browser/network/remote queue delay.
protocol.scoring: Saved comparison checked against independent fixture answer keys with 0.5% relative tolerance; reply figures checked with signed mean, 0.6% relative / 0.006 absolute tolerance, time +/- 0.051 h, and both batch names. A pass requires completed turn, correct computed artifact, and all reply figures. Semantic wording still needs review.
limitations: Authored tasks on three public CHO deliveries; not a general-purpose external benchmark.
Six evidence cases with two paraphrased requests each; repeats are correlated, not independent questions.
Unchanged production ToolLoop forced on, direct deterministic route off, gateway retries disabled.
Fresh local platform per attempt, allow_unqualified model route, public provisional evidence only.
No scientific-cause, regulatory validation, production latency, or time-savings claim.
All final replies require semantic review; numeric presence alone is not correctness.
Cost is token-rate estimate; hosted compute invoices are not reconciled.
